about:
Alpha Plastics, Inc. operates from Coon Rapids, Minnesota, where it was founded in 1976. The company is family- and veteran-owned, drawing on over 100 years of combined experience among its team.

The shop specializes in plastic pressure forming and thermoforming, producing parts such as polycarbonate defrosting ducts, polyethylene shrouds and dump wagon tubs, polycarbonate access doors, and Kydex shrouds. It runs prototype, short-run, and long-run production, and offers value-added services including assembly, finishing, custom packaging, logistics support, and EMI coatings.

Alpha Plastics serves customers across the United States and ships to Mexico. Its client base includes brands such as Schwans (food processing), 3M (industrial), BAE Systems (defense), Life Touch (photography), Ariens (outdoor power equipment), and Jacobsen (turf equipment), indicating a reach into food, industrial, defense, imaging, and outdoor equipment sectors.

The company emphasizes its ability to handle difficult parts, lower custom part costs, rapid prototyping, and free estimates. Its ISO 9001:2015 certification and membership in the Society of Plastic Engineers underscore a commitment to quality standards.
